summary: The inspected HTTPS response did not include an HSTS header.
limitations: This is an observable configuration property, not proof of exploitation.
Only the configured path and response were inspected.

finding_proposals.title: HSTS header not observed on configured HTTPS response
finding_proposals.severity_rationale: Missing HSTS can reduce transport downgrade resistance but is not independently exploitable evidence.
finding_proposals.expected_behavior: The reviewed HTTPS endpoint is expected to return an appropriate Strict-Transport-Security policy.
finding_proposals.observed_behavior: The final in-scope response did not contain Strict-Transport-Security.
